name: GDP.pdf
protocol: Source export protocol; row-level protocol details are preserved when available.

explanation.en: A question passes only when every rubric criterion is met; the score is the mean over five runs, judged by Gemini 3.5 Flash, on the 100-item set.
explanation.zh: 只有满足全部 rubric 标准时该题才算通过；分数是在 100 题上、由 Gemini 3.5 Flash 评分、五次运行的平均。

summary.en: GDP.pdf tests models on expert questions about real professional PDF documents, supplied as images, with strict rubric grading.
summary.zh: GDP.pdf 用真实专业 PDF 文档（以图像提供）上的专家问题评估模型，采用严格 rubric 评分。

task_format.en: The model reads one real professional PDF supplied as base64 images and answers an expert question that is graded against a full set of atomic rubric criteria.
task_format.zh: 模型阅读一份以 base64 图像提供的真实专业 PDF，回答一个专家问题，并按一整套原子 rubric 标准评分。
